text: Groupe Bruxelles Lambert (GBL), the Brussels-based listed investment holding, controls Canyon Bicycles GmbH: GBL's portfolio page lists Canyon among its 'controlled/co-controlled stakes' with 52.6% of the share capital (30 June 2026); founder Roman Arnold remains a significant shareholder and Executive Chairman.
short: GBL controls Canyon with 52.6% of the share capital.

source.name: GBL: Portfolio - Canyon
source.quote: Performance DNA supported by the founder Roman Arnold, who remains a significant shareholder alongside GBL with active involvement as Executive Chairman
source.note: Same page lists Canyon under 'Controlled/co-controlled stakes' with 'Share capital (06/30/2026) 52.6%'.
